description: This file contains utility functions for error handling and classification specific to Microsoft Teams integration, including error formatting, extraction of error details, classification of send errors, and detection of revoked proxy errors.

methods.name: formatUnknownError
methods.description: Formats an unknown error into a string message.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object and not an array.

methods.name: extractStatusCode
methods.description: Extracts HTTP status code from an error object.

methods.name: extractErrorCode
methods.description: Extracts an error code string from an error object.

methods.name: extractRetryAfterMs
methods.description: Extracts retry-after duration in milliseconds from an error object.

methods.name: classifyMSTeamsSendError
methods.description: Classifies an error into categories for Teams message sending, such as auth, throttled, transient, permanent, or unknown.

methods.name: isRevokedProxyError
methods.description: Detects if an error is caused by a revoked Proxy in the Bot Framework SDK.

methods.name: formatMSTeamsSendErrorHint
methods.description: Provides user hints based on the classification of a Teams send error.
